newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada unemployment insurance recipients up in May.
newsitem.headline: Canada unemployment insurance recipients up in May.

text.p: The number of Canadians receiving regular employment insurance benefits rose 4.2 percent to a seasonally adjusted 593,000 in May from April, Statistics Canada said on Wednesday.
This broke a string of nine consecutive monthly declines but still left the number 17.4 percent below that of May 1996.
But a Statscan official cautioned that in unadjusted data, the number declined to 562,000 from 679,000 and said some of the rise could have been due to the seasonal adjustment factors.
Regular benefit payments declined for the fifth consecutive month, declining 4.8 percent during the month to a seasonally adjusted C$708 million.
And the number of new claimants continued to decline, by 2.6 percent, to a seasonally adjusted 223,000 from 229,000 in April.
For the year to date, claims were 11.6 percent below a year earlier, and payments were 11.3 percent down.
